ModulePrefs.title: tworods
ModulePrefs.author: Juan M. Aguirregabiria (http://tp.lc.ehu.es/jma.html); Fremont Teng; lookang
ModulePrefs.description: Two rods are dropped over a smooth table. In one case the end point on the table can slide without friction, while in the other case it may rotate around a horizontal smooth articulation. The simulation allows computing fall times and trajectories.
